name: the-swift-walk-refuses-an-empty-scan
find:
files = tuple(sorted(root.rglob("*.swift")))
    assert files, f"no Swift files under {root}, so this guard checked nothing"
    return files
breaks: an empty walk is cached, so a root that was empty once reads as empty for the rest of the process and every source-scanning sweep over it passes at the same moment (#1018, L286, L98)
